description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a Vampire due to Rukarumel, Timothar triggers, causing you to pay {1} and exile Eternal Scourge to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
